data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 午后天台上的逆光回眸
data.description: 旧校舍无人的天台铁丝网旁，狂风卷起雾枝拖曳至小腿的乌黑长发。黑色的制服裙摆在风中烈烈作响，她微微侧过苍白精致的脸颊，红瞳在刺目的逆光中闪烁着生人勿近的幽光。
data.location: abandoned high school rooftop next to rusted chainlink fencing against stormy dark skies
data.action: standing in violent gale against wire fence, floor-length straight raven hair whipping across frame, turning head with chilling aloof red eyes
data.lighting: dramatic backlit silver rim lighting from stormy clouds highlighting sheer black hair strands
data.mood: ominous dramatic intensity, gothic school mystery, breathtaking cold perfection
data.promptProse: Against a dark stormy sky on a school rooftop, Kirie floor-length black hair whips in the wind as she turns with piercing ruby eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kirie standing against the stormy sky on a school roof, immense black hair whipping in the wind.
